test: add camellia Docker smoke coverage (#47)

Summary:
- split the existing camellia smoke command into deploy and docker
  variants and run both from the default smoke entrypoint
- add a Docker smoke script that builds the camellia image, waits
  for container readiness, probes key routes, and prints logs on
  failure

Rationale:
- the original build artifact failure is no longer reproducible on
  origin/main, but the previous validation missed the real Docker
  deployment path used in production
- keeping Docker startup and route reachability in the smoke suite
  guards against regressions in packaging and runtime boot

Tests:
- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
- pnpm run check:camellia
- pnpm run smoke:camellia
- docker build -f apps/camellia/Dockerfile -t camellia-dam-45 .
- docker run --rm -d -p 3300:3000 --name camellia-dam-45 camellia-dam-45
- curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:3300/login
